reason: The whole point for me is running with my crew, and half of us are on iPhone, so the crew run room would be half empty on Saturday. I'm not going to split my crew across two apps just for points and virtual shoes I can't cash out.
objection: Android only kills the crew feature for us — I can't ask the iPhone half of my crew to stand on the sidelines, and solo it's just another GPS tracker plus a shoe-collecting game.
would_change_my_mind: An iPhone app so my whole crew can join the same run room.
